Overview

What Can a Good C&I ESS 
Do for Your Business?
Maximize Energy Revenue
Total Safety 
from Cell to System
Easy Installation 
and Commissioning

Power with Quality and Stability
Maximize Energy Revenue

With PCS efficiency of over 98.5% and intelligent liquid cooling, PowerStack 255CS series achieves round-trip efficiency of over 90% consistently. 
AI-driven thermal balance technology further cuts auxiliary power consumption by 33%, minimizing energy loss while maximizing performance.



Total Safety from Cell to System

Safety that runs through every step, from cell to system level. AI-powered cell management provides 
predictive protection, multistage overcurrent defense, and 3 levels of fire safety for complete peace of mind.  


Easy Installation and Commissioning

With an easy setup process, the system can be installed in a variety of configurations. Side-by-side, back-to-back, or face-to-face. Furthermore, setup just takes one click and 2 minutes. Its fully self-developed system also lessens commissioning time even more. 

Modular, seamless, parallel connections
Easier Installation
Automated software commissioning for quicker setup
Fully Setup 1~25 Units in 2 Minutes
Power with Quality and Stability

PowerStack 255CS series features grid-forming tech that adapts to complex grids while enabling active governance and off-grid solutions with MW-level black start. 
It ensures stable, efficient power for both grid-tied and off-grid use, perfectly meeting diverse commercial/industrial energy needs.

Easy O&M,
Thanks to iSolarCloud
With access to the iSolarCloud, you’ll be able to keep track and manage all aspects of your ESS system right from your phone, with minimal effort.

MC Series Modular Plants Proton Exchange Membrane (PEM) Electrolyser Systems
Summary

MC Series Modular Plants deliver megawatt scale performance in a containerized form for easy outdoor installations. Each process container features two 1.25 MW stacks with a shared balance of plant. A single modular unit consists of two process containers, two thermal cooling systems and one power supply enclosure. It can produce up to 984 Nm3/h of hydrogen gas on-demand. Multiple units are grouped together for larger hydrogen output needs. Typical applications include renewable energy storage, industrial process gas, and hydrogen fueling.
